name: sgct
description: The scalable and NDI features wrap proprietary SDKs whose licenses do not permit redistribution. They are off by default and a package built with them must not be handed to third parties.

The dependency list is kept in sync with the manifest at the root of the SGCT repository by support/vcpkg/check-manifest-sync.cmake, except that this port builds neither the unit tests nor Tracy support and therefore omits Catch2 and Tracy, and it depends on the vcpkg-cmake host tools explicitly.

ndi.description: Build SGCT with NDI support. Proprietary SDK, the resulting package cannot be redistributed

scalable.description: Build SGCT with Scalable SDK support. Proprietary SDK, the resulting package cannot be redistributed
